title: Farmer Golems
description: Copper Golems holding hoes now harvest in a 3x3 area around them!
body:
Super simple datapack that allows golems to harvest Wheat, Carrots, Potatoes, Beetroots, and Nether Warts in a 3x3 area around them if they're holding a hoe!

Perfect for adding more uses to the Copper Golem, specifically if you want them to be used in your farms adding a unique twist and life to your harvesting!
